reading.body:
Covariant raised $23.4 million in a filing dated June 2023, with the first sale of that offering recorded in November 2022.

The gap between first sale and filing is the only timing signal here. Money moved in late 2022 and the paperwork caught up in mid 2023, which is ordinary for venture rounds and says nothing about how the capital was spent. The offering and sold amounts are identical, so the round was fully subscribed at the stated figure.

What the record does not contain is the part that matters for an AI compute argument. There is no disclosure of headcount, hardware, data center footprint, or power draw. A robotics and AI company of this size would carry real compute costs, but none of that is visible in a Form D, which reports securities sold and not what the money buys.

The person attached to the company is Pieter Abbeel, listed as founder. No products are recorded, and the available site text is the company name alone. That absence is a limit of the data, not evidence that the company builds nothing.

profile_text.body:
Covariant is a for-profit startup, according to the company's own site at covariant.ai. The site text available for the company consists of its name alone, with no description of what it makes or does.

No products are recorded for Covariant, and no lawsuits, regulatory cases, or other filings are noted.
